# nico_expected_rack_group (Resource)

Expected Rack Group declares an external topology identifier, racks, and device members for an NVLink domain. Manufacturer and physical location are conveyed through the same well-known `chassis.*` and `location.*` labels used by Expected Racks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nico_expected_rack_group" "example" {
  site_id                        = "site-id-value"
  rack_group_id                  = "rack-group-id-value"
  topology                       = "topology-value"
  protocol                       = "protocol-value"
  name                           = "name-value"
  description                    = "description-value"
  labels                         = {
    key = "value"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `protocol` (String) Rack fabric protocol, non-blank and at most 128 characters. `NVLINK_V6` enables GB-to-VR profile topology normalization.
- `rack_group_id` (String) Operator-supplied identifier for the rack group (opaque string; UUID syntax is not required). Must be non-empty and unique within the Site.
- `site_id` (String) ID of the Site the Expected Rack Group belongs to
- `topology` (String) External group-level NVLink topology identifier, non-blank and at most 128 characters.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes. An empty string is allowed.
- `labels` (Map of String) User-defined key-value pairs with ASCII keys and Unicode values, each at most 255 UTF-8 bytes. Well-known keys (`chassis.*`, `location.*`) are used to convey chassis identity and physical location.
- `name` (String) ASCII human-readable name, at most 256 characters. An empty string is allowed.
- `racks` (Attributes List) Ordered racks and their devices. Rack IDs and device identity tuples must be unique across the group, with case-sensitive comparison. A provided array replaces the complete list; on PATCH, omission or null preserves it and [] clears it. On create, omission or null supplies an empty list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--racks))

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) ISO 8601 datetime when the Expected Rack Group was created
- `id` (String) The resource ID.
- `site` (String) Site details when requested through includeRelation; otherwise null.
- `updated` (String) ISO 8601 datetime when the Expected Rack Group was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--racks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `racks`

Read-Only:

- `members` (Attributes List) Ordered devices in this rack. Device identities are unique across all racks in the group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--racks--members))
- `rack_id` (String) Non-blank, case-sensitive external rack identifier, unique within the group.

<a id="nestedatt--racks--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `racks.members`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Non-blank opaque external device inventory identifier.
- `manufacturer` (String) Non-blank manufacturer name.
- `type` (String) Case-sensitive REST rack component type. NVSwitch maps to Switch in Core.
